description: This file contains the interface definition for IStreaming_ProducerGrain, which is a grain interface in an Orleans-based project, including method signatures related to producing and managing streaming data.

classes.name: IStreaming_ProducerGrain
classes.description: An interface representing a streaming producer grain with methods to control production and manage state.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Initializes the grain as a producer with specified stream ID, provider, and namespace.

methods.name: StopBeingProducer
methods.description: Stops the grain from acting as a producer.

methods.name: ProduceSequentialSeries
methods.description: Produces a sequence of items in order.

methods.name: ProduceParallelSeries
methods.description: Produces a sequence of items in parallel.

methods.name: GetExpectedItemsProduced
methods.description: Returns the expected number of items to be produced.

methods.name: GetItemsProduced
methods.description: Returns the actual number of items produced.

methods.name: AddNewConsumerGrain
methods.description: Adds a new consumer grain to receive streaming items.

methods.name: GetProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active producers.

methods.name: VerifyFinished
methods.description: Verifies that streaming has completed, marked with AlwaysInterleave attribute.
